boilerplate.report_intro: This report sets out an informal gap assessment against the Cyber Security and Information Assurance principle (FSyP 7) of the ONR Security Assessment Principles (SyAPs). Each regulatory expectation is recorded as Achieved, Partially achieved or Not achieved against the selected dutyholder profile. The roadmap, drawn from the evidence gathered, covers the expectations that are not yet achieved or could not be verified.
boilerplate.not_formal_caveat: This gap analysis is intended to support improvement. It is not an ONR assessment or inspection and does not determine compliance with the Nuclear Industries Security Regulations 2003. It neither constitutes nor approves a security plan. The judgements are the consultant's, made against the published SyAPs expectations, and should be confirmed through the dutyholder's own arrangements and, where required, with ONR.
boilerplate.how_to_read: Each regulatory expectation is assessed as Achieved, Partially achieved or Not achieved. The results are reported for each Fundamental Security Principle as counts of these states, and there is no overall score. An expectation that could not be verified is marked Unknown, which lowers confidence in the results. The selected dutyholder profile sets how much demonstration is expected. The roadmap lists every in-scope expectation that is not yet achieved or could not be verified.
boilerplate.series_context: The Security Assessment Principles (SyAPs) are published by the Office for Nuclear Regulation and set out what ONR expects of a dutyholder's security arrangements. This assessment covers the cyber security and information assurance principle and draws on the Technical Assessment Guides that support it.

templates.exec_verdict_nogaps: This assessment covers the Cyber Security and Information Assurance principle (FSyP 7) of the ONR Security Assessment Principles (SyAPs). Against the {profileName} profile, {clientName} {verdictPhrase}, and every in-scope expectation was assessed as Achieved.

templates.exec_confidence: These findings rest on answers for {coveragePct} of applicable expectations ({confidenceLabel}). SyAPs does not produce a single grade, so the results are reported as counts of Achieved, Partially achieved and Not achieved expectations for each Fundamental Security Principle.

verdictPhrases.foundations: demonstrates strong alignment with the expectations
verdictPhrases.recognised: is partly aligned with the expectations

gapConcentrationFragments.mostlyClause: most expectations are achieved but some are not
gapConcentrationFragments.absentClause: the expectations are not yet demonstrated

boilerplate.exec_partial_vs_absent: An expectation marked Partially achieved has some elements in place, so closing it extends work already begun. An expectation marked Not achieved has not yet been demonstrated and needs new arrangements, which usually take more time and money.
boilerplate.regulatory_stakes: ONR uses the Security Assessment Principles to judge the effectiveness of a dutyholder's security arrangements under the Nuclear Industries Security Regulations 2003. ONR engagement, a security plan review or internal assurance would focus on the expectations below the expected state.
